steps.premise: An order includes over ten complete rolls.
steps.action: The order qualifies for the discount.
steps.quote: The discount applies to orders of more than ten whole rolls.

steps.action: The larger gear drives the smaller gear.
steps.quote: The diagram shows the large gear driving the small gear.

steps.action: The clock lets a spring unwind.
steps.quote: The clock keeps its hands moving during a power cut by unwinding a spring.

steps.action: The lights in the courtyard stay on.
steps.quote: The courtyard remains lit up to the closing of the final stall.

steps.action: One glaze took longer to dry than the other.
steps.quote: In the trial, the two glazes took different amounts of time to dry.

steps.action: The separator uses a magnet on the mixture.
steps.consequence: The steel beads are separated from the mixture.
steps.quote: The separator removes the steel beads from the mixture with a magnet.

steps.action: The bakery added a cashier.
steps.quote: Bringing in another cashier reduced the length of the line at the bakery.

steps.premise: The rising water reaches the upper mark.
steps.action: The tank alarm goes off.
steps.quote: The tank alarm sounds when the water level rises to the upper mark.

steps.action: The museum commissioned the guild to appraise the bronze figure.
steps.quote: The guild was hired by the museum to value the bronze figure.

steps.premise: The delivery receipt lacks a signature.
steps.action: The receipt loses its validity.
steps.quote: A missing signature invalidates the delivery receipt.

steps.action: Someone fastens the drawer latch.
steps.quote: Engaging the latch prevents the drawer from sliding open.

steps.action: The wheels of the cart roll uphill.
steps.quote: The cart slows on the test track because its wheels climb an incline.

steps.premise: A parcel is still on the platform at midnight.
steps.action: The depot includes that parcel in its count.
steps.quote: The depot counts parcels left on the platform at midnight.

steps.premise: A team completes both stages within the time limit.
steps.action: The team thereby qualifies.
steps.quote: Finishing the two stages within the allotted time is enough for a team to qualify.

steps.action: The archive compares the skyline in the photo with skylines on maps of known dates.
steps.consequence: The archive determines the date of the photo.
steps.quote: The archive dates the photograph by matching the skyline to dated maps.

steps.premise: A jar has a cracked lid.
steps.action: The jar is excluded from the tally.
steps.quote: Jars whose lids are cracked are left out of the count.

steps.action: The inspector checked the west gauge against the east gauge.
steps.quote: The inspector used the east gauge to check the west gauge.

steps.action: The partner reimbursed the studio for framing.
steps.quote: The studio got its framing costs back from the partner.

steps.premise: A passenger is travelling on a single ticket.
steps.action: The fare rule bars the passenger from breaking the journey.
steps.quote: The fare rule forbids a passenger to interrupt a journey on a single ticket.

steps.action: The canopy gives the bench shade.
steps.quote: The canopy shades the bench and thereby keeps it cooler.

steps.action: The locker rental is renewed.
steps.quote: Renewing a locker rental changes the access code.

steps.action: The survey rates the canal route as more accessible than the ridge route.
steps.quote: The survey ranks the canal route above the ridge route for accessibility.

steps.action: The clerk first puts a stamp on the form.
steps.consequence: The applicant signs the form afterward.
steps.quote: The clerk stamps the form before the applicant signs it.

steps.action: The north branch borrowed the south branch’s spare scanner from the south branch.
steps.quote: The south branch lent its spare scanner to the north branch.
